description: VSA conceptual and fundamental formula questions (2 Marks)
rubric_guidelines: Step-by-step marking rubric with 1 mark for definition/principle and 1 mark for conclusive statement.

description: Short descriptive and derivation questions (3 Marks)
rubric_guidelines: Detailed point-wise rubric: 1 mark for statement/formula, 1 mark for working steps, 1 mark for final result.

description: Contextual, scenario, or practical laboratory analytical questions (4 Marks)
rubric_guidelines: Analytical rubric: 1 mark context/principle, 2 marks working/derivation, 1 mark practical interpretation.

description: Long descriptive, comprehensive proof, essay, or circuit/ray diagram analysis (5 Marks)
rubric_guidelines: Exhaustive evaluation rubric: 1 mark statement, 3 marks comprehensive derivations/proof/diagram, 1 mark conclusions/units.
